notes.title: First Mow Meow Steam update! 🐈🎉
notes.notes:
[b]Mow Meow's first update is here[/b]! And what's new? A setting menu! 🤯
Wow, I know! But guess what..? Added official ultrawide support too, and before Elden Ring!!! 🤺

[h2]v0.1.666 notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Settings menu, hit esc [resolution change and full screen toggles for now]
[*] Ultrawide support [32:9 totally needed for a game like this]
[*] Can leave to main menu from settings menu meow [need to add that exit button eh?]
[*] Adjusted vignette for different aspect ratios [woo?]
[*] Chat now scales and positions properly on all aspect ratios [meow!]
[/list]

[h3]Lots more planned.. Thank you for your support! 🙏[/h3]
